t: 2030 — First governed service hulls field trials: service logistics mon
title: 2030 — First governed service hulls field trials: service logistics mon
definition: 2030 milestone on the Smoke Forecasting Services roadmap.
description:
First governed service hulls field trials: service logistics monitoring published openly, health alerts oversight in place.

What must be true first: the smoke models results have to replicate outside the lab, service logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and health alerts operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed smoke models demonstrations, service logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting health alerts uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Smoke Forecasting Services Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Smoke Forecasting Services operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Smoke Forecasting Services installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 71181 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where smoke models monitoring, service logistics redundancy, or health alerts maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Smoke Forecasting Services Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Smoke Forecasting Services: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Smoke Forecasting Services — services forecasting wildfire smoke.

Phase 1 — Prove (smoke models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (service logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (health alerts): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (sensor nets): service hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and regions-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
